MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 1, 6

2. Solve for x: x + 6 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 6
   C. 7
   D. 6

3. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 73
   C. 1
   D. 17

4. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 10

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 156

6. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 2
   C. 24
   D. 25

7. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 49

8. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.025

9. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 3/4
   D. 2/3

10. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 17
   D. 0

11. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 12

12. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
